cost: Selected fixtures bounded by seven tiny programs plus state/fault cases. Existing frozen and recursion tests have separate unmeasured costs; no whole-harness coverage claim.
description: VM/tree equivalence test harness: frozen suites and large edge library coexist with selected bounded synthetic state/fallback/fault checks.
forward: run creates capture interpreter with vm/fault then returns output and state. Selected wave30 tests assert expected bytes, tree/VM parity, fallback counters, parse/runtime workspace behavior and fail-fast fault mismatch.
inverse: Passing selected assertions admits untested divergent programs; parity alone admits shared wrong output, so synthetic cases also assert independent expected strings.
limitations: Partial lexical syntax, no macro expansion or semantic resolution. Finite synthetic CPU checks are not a proof. Frozen suites, corpus, teacher, GPU, allocation exhaustion and host IO failure injection were not run. No useful executable percent surrogate for categorical control/effects; unsupported gap, no 1/2/5/10% claim.
state: Selected synthetic tests use memory filesystem and finite small loops; frozen suite and EDGE recursion functions remain unexecuted in this epoch.
